pages.text: $(t4)Tier 4$(end) bosses are the hardest content in the pack. Full $(t4)Tier 4$(end) gear is strongly recommended. Deep Aether, End, and Ultimate Bosses all require preparation.

$(bold)Ender Dragon$(/bold) — Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Waking Lichblade$(/l) (25% — highest in the pack), Dragon Heart, Dragon Scale. $(bold)Deep Aether Boss$(/bold) — EOTS Controller. Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Flamewind$(/l) (18%), $(t4)T4$(end) boss materials.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss Bosses$(/bold) — 6 bosses across the Abyss: The Other Side dimension. $(warn)Note: 6 Abyss weapon IDs are pending in-game registry verification.
